title: SWF: MATRIX encoding accuracy for rotated/skewed instances
description: Verify that MATRIX encoding in PlaceObject2 correctly encodes rotation and skew for SymbolInstances. SWF MATRIX is bit-packed: HasScale (scaleX/scaleY), HasRotate (skewX/skewY), translateX/Y. Check packages/swf/src/compile.ts or shapes.ts where matrices are encoded. For a 45-degree rotation, verify the skew fields contain cos(45°)*65536 and sin(45°)*65536 (fixed-point). Add 6 tests in __tests__/matrix.test.ts: identity, scale, rotation at 0/45/90, combined scale+rotation, translation only.
